description: This file contains implementation of bit-shifting operations (left shift and right shift) for big number (BIGNUM) structures, part of a cryptographic library, specifically for the BN (Big Number) module.

methods.name: BN_lshift
methods.description: Performs left shift operation on a big number by n bits.

methods.name: BN_rshift
methods.description: Performs right shift operation on a big number by n bits.
